scope: Unsigned expression-register boxing and unboxing. General integer-register lowering and the ordinary integer language contract remain open.

typedLowering.eligibility: Operands must come from checked uint64 literal or arithmetic/unary producer nodes; an inferred type alone does not prove representation because as assertions are erased.
typedLowering.dynamicBoundary: Preserves the exact unsigned bits and boxes only values that a double cannot represent exactly.

cases: Rust and threaded interpreter unsigned registers
JIT leaf and compiled task frames
All 64 payload bits, including the ERROR sentinel bit pattern
Numeric table keys and graph snapshots

compatibilityRegressions: An erased uint64 assertion over a signed negative operand retains wrapping wide-helper arithmetic.
An erased uint64 assertion over a fractional operand retains truncating wide-helper arithmetic.
An erased uint64 assertion over an int64 box retains its exact original kind until an operation creates a new value.
remaining: Ordinary integer wrapping and division semantics across checker, slots, and every lowering path.
General typed local and parameter propagation while preserving erased assertion behavior.
Native unsigned instruction handlers in the threaded C core; new opcodes currently use its Rust slow path.
